title: Session request
description: A request for a session that speaks for one account, which the catalogue's balance checks read (REQ-CAT-3). That it ends after it is asked for is checked by the Rust types.

request.description: The request's id, which its answer names.

holder.description: The party that holds the account.

requester.description: Who asks: the holder or its delegate.

until.description: When the session is to end, by Core's clock.

at.description: When, by Core's clock, the one it passes as at.
